review_description: The sales process was made really easy and comfortable, with lots of good information, a really good product that has more than met my needs for now and into the future, and a salesman who was friendly, knowledgeable and understood what I needed.  The pre-inspection confirmed readiness and no unexpected extras.  The installation happened really quickly (due to someone else cancelling/re-scheduling) and the team were great to deal with.  Everything is working as expected and we're getting great results from the batteries, with full home backup to provide security for outages.

Can't fault Limitless Energy Solutions.From system planning, quotation all the way through to ithe install and commissioning was completed in and extremely professional manner.The timeframe from initial contact to install was just over a month.We had three systems quoted. I was initially only considering Sigenergy and Sungrow. Simon from sales recommended we consider Deye as well as it was great value for money.Extremely glad Deye was recommended and that is what we went for after carefully considering all options.The install has just been completed. There was an issue with a CT which took a little troubleshooting but was identified and resolved by the installation team on a second visit.Correspondence during the whole process was fantastic and prompt. All visits were kept to as per the booking times with great SMS notification.Limitless will monitor your system and assist with showing you how it runs. So once the install is done they are available for assistance into the future - brilliant!Initial system was a 10kW PV with an AC coupled Sungrow inverter running to a 5kW Eveready battery added a few years after the PV install.After a site inspection Limitless suggested we go from AC coupling to DC coupling, getting rid of the isolators (a failure point) and bringing the system up to current spec. Remove the Sungrow inverter and upgrade the 5kW Eveready to a 30kW Deye battery matching it with a 12kW Deye inverter. The bonus was to also have pretty much full house UPS backup except for the pool pump and pool heat pump.Couldn't be happier with the whole process so far.Well done Limitless.

Limitless designed and installed our fairly large home solar and battery system with full integration with our EV charging, and to supply our all electric totally heat pump home systems.Really excellent design, planning, communication, installation, commissioning, system integration and operational support - couldn’t ask for anything better, they did a really good job.Ignoring the capital costs involved, we now have average monthly bills less than $100 to cover all our home energy needs, heating, cooling, pool pumps, cooking, household electrics, hot water, plus all energy to our two EVs.Previously with gas and electric for home, and ICE cars, our average monthly energy + fuel costs were $740!!
Excellent service, fantastic product. Exactly what we needed. So happy with the installation. Wish we had done it sooner.  Helpful with information and the guys were awesome.

Knowledgeable sales person able to suggest the system that suits our needs.Installation was smooth going, neat and tidy. installers were polite and friendly, they even removed shoes coming into my house.

Sales and quoting process was easy and very informative.The workers doing the Installation did a great job. They even went over and above, removing leaves from the roof valleys.Customer service was great too, every company has issues, but the sign of a good company is how they deal with them.On the day we had an issue, but limitless sorted this out within an hour.Great outcome and I am very happy.I highly recommend this company.

I had a 6kw system with a 25kw battery installed in my home in inner-north Melbourne through Limitless, who were fantastic. Simon was very helpful throughout the sales/quoting process, helping me through the Victorian rebate schemes. Dean was very knowledgeable and communicated great throughout the inspection and installation stages, particularly with optimising our system around a neighbour's tree that block a bit of our roof in the winter. We also had a thorough rundown of how the system works and they helped set up the app on our phone. We had the installation in August and the battery powered most of our overnight heating even through winter!

A very simple and easy process from sales to post installation, Limitless handles everything!We live in an area where we get a fair few blackouts, which having solar has already helped in that regards and also lowers our power bills as a bonus.Could not recommend Deye any higher! great value you for money, having the full home back up and their monitoring app is very easy to use and navigate. The option to have Deye CoPilot and also a generator outlet to charge the battery as back up, is next level!

The quoting process was extremely easy and the sales and administration team were very responsive. They happily answered questions about products, brands as well as technical questions about my desired system.Installation was done on time and efficiently. The team were professional, polite and ensured there was nothing left to clean up. The installation process was extremely neat and tidy and clearly installed by highly skilled professionals.Looking forward to getting Trent and the team back to install a battery in the not too distant future.
Couldn't ask for a better team and results. Absolutely worthwhile and paying for itself. Highly recommended.

Above and beyond across all aspects of the installation. The communication and attention to detail in the design and pricing stage was impressive. The quality of the installation and after care service has also been to very high level. Would certainly recommend using Limitless for all things solar and renewables.

I wanted to upgraded my solar system to solar + Battery and have been very happy with the Deye product that the guys at Limitless advised and all its features.I chose a larger battery system size which makes your property fully self sufficient and allows you to monetise your battery storage in the whole sale market with the Deye copilot AI software.As it stands now I not only don’t pay bills, but am actually in credit with my retailer.Extremely happy with the experience

We were keen to take advantage of the new government rebates for solar panels and a battery to be installed in our home. After obtaining the recommended quotes from three suppliers, we requested follow-up advice from all three but only Limitless Energy Solutions responded immediately. They visited in person and spent considerable time evaluating the suitability of our roof for hosting the panels and a location for the battery. Their advice was patient, thorough and very informative given that our roof space and layout  is complex with its many sections and valleys. It was explained that due to excessive shading from nearby trees that are protected by a heritage overlay, the best installation arrangement was one comprising of just 14 solar panels and a 16 kWh battery.  We were so assured by this advice such that we decided then and there to go with them for the task. Incredibly, we only had to wait 4 weeks for the acquisition of the panels and battery (despite the burgeoning public demand) and for the work to commence. The quality of the installation was outstanding and was completed quickly and our property was left clean and tidy afterwards. The certification of the electrical work was completed just two working days later. The follow-up by the company to ensure that all was working as planned was excellent. We are extremely happy with the performance of our system at this early stage and have nothing but the praise for, and recommendation of, Limitless Energy Solutions.

The service from start to finish was proactive and informative. The team made me feel comfortable with the process and products that were being installed. The quote and cost was competitive to other providers in the market. The install went smoothly and on schedule. Couldn’t be happier.

I reached out to Limitless to install solar and batteries on my new owner built house. They worked with me through the whole process from construction to completion. The installation team ensured it looked amazing with cables hidden in walls, minimal ducting and a recessed switchboard. The consultation was very helpful giving me great options to choose from. I’ve been in the house for over 6 months now and my bill is well into credit even without a huge amount of storage. Limitless recently returned to upgrade my battery storage so that I can sell stored energy back to the grid. The system runs incredibly efficiently. I am constantly checking the iSolar app to see how well the system is running and to show other people how good it is. I would highly recommend Limitless and the products they supply, (Sungrow for me), for anyone looking to get the perfect dollar and battery set up.

From the beginning Limitless Energy were supportive and professional. I had numerous constructive conversations with the sales team to work out what was going to be the best solar solution for our family. Installation ran smoothly and on time. Communication was great and absolutely no mess was left behind. They went through how to monitor the system using the app, which is very easy to use. It was a seamless process, great customer service.

Thanks to the entire team at Limitless Energy Solutions for the great experience in getting my solar and battery installed. No pushy sales just fantastic advice and service. Added panels to our roof to facilitate a 20kw/h battery. Installed professionally and on time with the installation crew doing an awesome job. Could not be happier.
Very happy with limitless  was very helpful  explain everything very clean

I recently had a 10.5kW solar system with a battery installed for $15,000 and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, efficient, and easy to deal with. They explained everything clearly, answered all my questions, and kept me updated throughout the whole process.The installation was neat and completed on time, and the system has been performing exactly as promised. It feels great to already see the savings on my power bills and know I’m more energy independent.Overall, excellent value for money and fantastic service. Highly recommend them to anyone considering solar!

I found working with Limited very easy.  Simon was the only one of the quotes that I received who noticed that SolarEdge was offering a special $0 Invertor upgrade.  Once he packed this in, they were the best value by a clear margin.On top of that they and their installers were a pleasure to work with.  Quick, tidy, efficient and friendly.

The quoting process was fine.The installers arrived on time and kept in touch letting me know when they were on the way. The young man in charge was particularly helpful and competent at his job.  They were polite and left the yard clean and tidy.The company managed all the connections and installed an app on my phone to show how the panels were working.

I am very happy with Limited Energy.1. Quote - Simon is very patient and he discussed different inverter brand option with me.  The quote is not cheapest but very reasonable.2. From quote to installation took less than 1 month.3. The installation team is professional- the working area is neat , they checked and replaced the roof tiles before putting the solar panel up.4. The after installation service is great ! I get answer about activating the energy account quickly.Highly recommend !

We recently had solar panels installed at our home by Limitless Energy, and we couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, the team was extremely accommodating to our specific needs. They took the time to thoroughly understand our current energy usage as well as our future consumption expectations, and worked tirelessly to design and install the perfect system for our household.Their professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to customer satisfaction truly set them apart. Every step of the process was handled with care, and they made sure we were fully informed and comfortable with all decisions. The installation was smooth and efficient, and the end result exceeded our expectations.We’re now enjoying the benefits of clean, sustainable energy with the confidence that our system is built to support us well into the future. We highly recommend Limitless Energy to anyone considering solar – they’re knowledgeable, reliable, and genuinely care about getting it right for their customers.

We had a really great experience with limitless.Simon worked really hard to build the solar system we were after at a competitive rate and the whole install process was super easy.Installers were polite and on time and we are really happy with the overall result.We are Planning to install batteries in the future and will definitely use there guys again
